Let's denote the number of cookies Henry baked last year as x. According to the problem, he wants to make twice as many as he did last year, so he plans to bake 2x cookies.

When he finishes baking, he realizes he actually baked 15 more cookies than he meant to, so he actually baked 2x + 15 cookies.

He drops 5 cookies as he is putting them out to cool, so the total number of cookies he has now is 110.

So, we can write the equation:

2x + 15 - 5 = 110

Simplifying the equation:

2x + 10 = 110

Subtract 10 from both sides:

2x = 100

Divide both sides by 2:

x = 50

Henry baked 50 cookies last year.
